title: Interactive 3D Cyber-Grid Retro-Tech Landing Page
overview: Development of a high-fidelity, interactive landing page featuring a 3D wireframe model of a 1980s-style desktop computer. The experience combines a 'Cyber-Grid' aesthetic (neon cyan, glowing vertices, glitch effects) with a retro-futuristic UI, including glassmorphic navigation and a system status panel, all rendered via Three.js/WebGL.

userStories.want: To interact with a 3D wireframe of a vintage computer
userStories.soThat: They can experience a high-end, immersive retro-tech aesthetic.

userStories.want: A responsive navigation bar and system status panel
userStories.soThat: They can navigate the site and view status info regardless of their device.

functionalRequirements: Render a 3D wireframe model of a 1980s desktop (CRT monitor, keyboard, tower) using Three.js or a high-performance WebGL library.
Implement continuous, steady rotation of the 3D model on its Y-axis.
Apply 'Cyber-Grid' styling: neon cyan lines, glowing vertices, and a periodic 'glitch' effect.
Implement a deep charcoal gradient background with a CRT scanline overlay.
Create a glassmorphic navigation bar at the top of the viewport.
Create a 'System Status' info-panel in the bottom corner of the viewport.
Ensure the 3D scene initializes automatically upon page load without placeholders.
nonFunctionalRequirements: Performance: High-performance WebGL rendering to ensure smooth 60fps animation.
Responsiveness: The layout and 3D scene must scale correctly for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Maintainability: All styles and scripts must be modularized for production-ready deployment.
Visual Fidelity: High-quality neon and glow effects must be consistent across different hardware.
acceptanceCriteria: 3D model renders immediately on load with no placeholder assets.
The 3D model rotates smoothly on the Y-axis without stuttering.
The 'Cyber-Grid' visual effects (neon, glow, glitch) are clearly visible.
The navigation bar and System Status panel utilize glassmorphic styling.
The page is fully responsive and functional across multiple screen resolutions.
The CRT scanline overlay is visible over the background and 3D scene.
